notes.title: Check out Prism Warriors DX during Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes: [p]Steam Next Fest is underway, and [i]Prism Warriors DX[/i] now has a demo available for you to play![/p][p]The demo contains:[/p][list][*][p]All seven playable characters, with their unique Passive and Special abilities[/p][/*][*][p]Stage 1 of the main campaign[/p][/*][*][p]One unlockable Prism Duel bonus battle[/p][/*][*][p]Four White Label difficulty modifiers, and five White Label difficulty modifiers[/p][/*][*][p]24 bespoke achievements[/p][/*][/list][p]I am only a solo developer, so getting feedback from others before the game releases is very important to me. I'm particularly interested in any bugs I may have overlooked, or any balancing issues (is one Prism Warrior too easy to play as? Is the Prism Duel too easy for a post-game bonus boss? Etc.).[/p][p]Please [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3514400/Prism_Warriors_DX/"]wishlist the game[/url] if you haven't already, let me know your thoughts about the demo, and I hope you'll buy the full game when it releases later this year![/p]
